annotations.title: Record every visit, or only the ones that matter

description: Choose which visits this site records. every_visit (the default): every visit is recorded from its first page, bounces included. problems_only: a visit is recorded only when it matters — a JavaScript error, a rage or dead click, a form left, or a key page such as checkout, cart, contact or sign-up — and then from its start, the lead-up included. A preview by default: without confirm: true it answers the choice that would be saved and saves nothing — show that to the owner and save only once they agree. With confirm: true it saves; the site uses it from its next page view. Called with no capture it answers what is saved now.

capture.description: every_visit records every visit; problems_only only the ones that matter.

confirm.description: true saves. Leave it out for the preview, which saves nothing.

fields.description: Top-level keys to keep, e.g. ["kpis"] — envelope keys, not metric names. See the server instructions.
